actual_prime_witness.statement: A normalized restricted row p^(-it0) is exactly flat and lies exactly in any row span containing t0; its augmented Gram determinant is zero.

claim_boundary: This artifact disproves only universal flat-vector distance or augmented-determinant lower bounds and replaces them by an anchor-aware alternative. It does not bound either anchor or transverse branch, close the skeleton target, improve zero density, or improve intervals.

dimension_boundary.statement: For full column rank with k>=N, every detector lies in the row span; invertibility confirms rather than excludes reconstruction.

anchor_reformulation.anchor_branch: small alpha_r gives a weighted sum of restricted prime kernels K_S(t-t_a)
anchor_reformulation.one_anchor_identity: if d_p=c p^(-it0) on S, then <x_t,d> is conjugate(c) K_S(t-t0) up to the pinned inner-product convention
anchor_reformulation.transverse_branch: positive alpha_r plus full-span reconstruction requires a many-row arithmetic theorem

exact_replay.correction: universal flat-vector distance lower bound is false on actual prime rows

prior_context.prior_role: flat-support ladder retained; universal square-rung distance gate corrected

replacement_gate.statement: Few-anchor reconstruction must yield a weighted restricted-prime-kernel recurrence bound; reconstruction transverse to every X^o(1)-anchor span must yield a many-row arithmetic exterior-volume bound.
